observations: Exact fx-880BTG PLUS, native full key sequences. Exploratory probes preserve all actual keys, including first AC returning to an existing expression. Clean HOME/Calculate-separated holdouts follow.

Back, AC, EXE and OK dismiss Calculate errors into the existing editor. A second AC clears input. Digits, DEL, arrows, SETTINGS and CATALOG are ignored while the error is open. SHIFT still lights S; SHIFT+AC consumes SHIFT and leaves the error open. ON clears the expression; HOME leaves the application.
MathI Math/R and LineI R indicators remain on Math/Syntax errors.
After a zero-denominator stacked fraction, Back places the cursor after the fraction; a domain error in a radical returns inside its argument.
Back from the Calculate input screen returns HOME. Includes empty and nonempty input after an error.
English Math ERROR and Back have separate clean samples; language changes are made before creating the error.

ClassPad can ignore rapid keys during/after ON restart. This timing issue is deferred. Clean error holdouts are recaptured through HOME/Calculate; the ON-dismiss test ends with ON and records the ready empty display.
